snippet.title: Official HandFoot demo release teaser
snippet.description:
HandFoot is a chaotic third-person action game inspired by 80s and 90s trash horror, where every gun is also a melee weapon.

HandFoot demo is out now on Steam, free to play!

 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4076630/HandFoot/

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/6YpKHSYxDH

Subscribe for more trash: https://www.youtube.com/@DankoEntartainment

#HandFoot #IndieGame #BoomerShooter #TrashHorror #Steam #SteamNextFest #Horror #IndieDev
